readings.moment: When the temple struck nine, at the New Year's Eve dinner table, as the husband had everyone show their watches
When the temple struck nine, during the watch-showing at the dinner table
While Mme Monnier and Casimir were playing piquet in the salon
A moment after Casimir came back from fetching his cigars

durations: A moment after he came back (between Casimir's return and the hall clock striking eleven; no length given)
whereabouts: At dinner, when the temple struck nine, everyone at the table was asked to show their watches, and Félix's watch was shown there
After dinner, Mme Monnier and Casimir played piquet in the salon
Casimir went out to fetch his cigars during the piquet game, after the temple struck ten
Mme Monnier did not look at the clock when Casimir went out; she was looking at her cards
While Casimir was out, Mme Monnier sat at the piano and played Chopin at his request, until he came back
Mme Monnier stopped playing when Casimir came back in
Casimir came back in, and a moment later the hall clock struck eleven
